decision_cruda.rationale: E595-06 holds 256 t at 15.4 g/t (~127 oz), and Este trucks and stockpile have room (inflow 36 against 72 t/h capacity). LH-01 is not expected back until 12:30 to 14:30. LH-08 comes from the cheapest source, the preparation heading at 1.9 oz/h, and takes 0.53 h to arrive. It can load about 190 t (~95 oz) by 17:00 against about 13 oz of development lost. C538-03 is not covered: Central is truck-limited (inflow 118 against 91 t/h), and LH-05 is likely back at 11:30. LH-09 stays put because it is on the critical path (4.0 oz/h). LH-10 is in maintenance until 11:00. Radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed.
